posts.author: silversteampunk
posts.body:
I made a ton of basic 48 x 48 tilesets for people who want to make their own unique tilesets for their RPG Maker games but DON’T wanna have to reinvent the wheel with getting certain patterns and geometry to line up. (Something I was desperately trying to find myself without luck) I also made a greybox tileset with tons of primitive shapes to help plan out levels!  These in particular I thought could be helpful for non-rpg maker games as well.
Commercial and Non-Commercial Use
Feel free to use and modify for your own projects
Let me know what you think! Feedback is always appreciated!  And of course I’d love to see anything you make with these!
Just in case, I've archived these on tumblr as well [

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
This is super cool--thanks for sharing! Reminds me of how you might plot out the basics of a map in the Source map editor with their placeholder textures and such, haha. I could see it being really handy to map a lot of layouts and such out with it!
And, even just as they are, they have a really stylish feel to them that could work for a surreal style game all of its own.
